ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory ongoing screening of all UBOs, directors, incorporation signatories and key counterparties against UN Security Council sanctions lists, EU consolidated financial sanctions under Article 215 TFEU, the French national asset-freeze list and, where USD rails are used, OFAC administered lists. Politically Exposed Persons are assessed on senior function, family and close-associate relationships, and transaction complexity. Any suspicion is reported to TRACFIN; failure to identify a beneficial owner is an obstacle to incorporation and triggers refusal by the registry.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique électronique des formalités d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), with pre-filing availability search through Infogreffe and the INPI Data Portal (data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name (dénomination sociale) may be in a foreign language but must be registered in Latin script. Corporate instruments and public filings require French language compliance under Constitution article 2 and Loi Toubon of 4 August 1994. Any non-Latin characters must be transliterated into a French or Latin-script version in the RCS filing.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any title likely to mislead the public or falsely imply public status, regulated activity, or official accreditation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French law does not grant a statutory pre-incorporation name reservation. The 30-day window is the internal clearance period applied while the articles of association are drafted. On rejection: (1) review the Guichet unique refusal notice identifying prior rights, prohibited terms, or missing authorizations; (2) if the conflict is a prior French or EU trademark, obtain a co-existence or consent letter or select an alternative name; (3) if the ground is a regulated token such as banque or assurance, obtain prior approval from the ACPR or competent ministry and restate the token in the statuts; (4) re-file the amended dossier at the Guichet unique; extension of an informal reservation is possible only through renewed INPI search and refreshed due-diligence lock; (5) if the registry refuses the RCS filing, appeal before the judge appointed to supervise the commercial register (juge commis à la surveillance du registre du commerce) within one month, or raise an administrative-law challenge before the competent administrative court as appropriate; (6) legal counsel must re-verify the new name before publication of the legal announcement.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a French SAS in the PR and communications sector, provided the registered office is addressed by a valid domiciliation agreement with an approved provider authorized to receive corporate mail and RCS notices. A purely virtual office is sufficient for RCS registration, but French tax and social authorities may assess the effective seat (siège réel) for commercial-substance purposes. The provider must be approved under Code de commerce article L.123-11-2.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. Residual annual risk estimated below 5% for a virtual-office, low-risk SAS in advertising and public relations absent red flags. Unannounced inspections are exceptional; DGFiP and URSSAF generally issue advance notice, except in fraud or tax-abuse investigations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code), articles L. 227-1 et seq. for Société par actions simplifiée
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte de constitution et statuts de la SAS
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum capital requirement of 1 euro for SAS; no escrow account required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The first Board of Directors of the Company resolves as follows: 1. The Company subscribes to 100% of its share capital amounting to 1 euro, represented by one share with a nominal value of 1 euro. 2. The registered office is established at the address specified in the statuts. 3. The following officers are appointed: [President Name] as Président, [Director Name] as Directeur, and [Secretary Name] as Secrétaire, each with full powers to bind the Company. 4. The President is authorized to sign all documents and handle all filings with the RCS and other authorities. This resolution is adopted unanimously in Paris on the date hereof.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Documents to the Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and sign the statuts de la SAS including corporate purpose, capital structure, registered office, and officer appointments. Upload scanned copies of shareholder IDs, proof of address, and the signed statuts via the online portal. Pay any applicable fees if required. The greffe will review and issue the SIREN number upon approval.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital account convertibility under EU and French law; no restrictions on profit remittances, dividends, or capital repatriation for resident French entities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion of export proceeds required under EU free movement of capital rules; services-based transactions (e.g., PR retainers) are fully convertible.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability; French regulations prohibit standalone offshore digital EMIs without local banking partnerships or correspondent relationships, due to strict AML and payment services directives.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial owners required for KYC interviews and account opening; remote digital onboarding not permitted for French-registered entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds from high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank references, beneficial ownership certificates, transaction history, and third-party verification reports
Purpose letters, client contracts, and supporting commercial documentation

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocols require SWIFT MT103 wires with purpose code 'CAPITAL' or 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION'; IBAN verification, beneficial ownership declaration, and source-of-funds evidence mandatory.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing via SWIFT MT103 for trade settlements; Commercial Letters of Credit issued through correspondent banks in target jurisdictions with full documentation trail.
